lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} {α β R ε : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 1 f →
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
      0 < α →
        0 < β →
          0 < R →
            0 < ε →
              ∀ {z x₀ : E},
                IsMinOn f Set.univ z →
                  ‖x₀ - z‖ ≤ R →
                    ∀ (A : E → ℝ → ℝ → E × ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℕ),
                      (∀ (y : E) (r δ : ℝ),
                          0 < r → 0 < δ → ‖y - z‖ ≤ r → f (A y r δ).1 - f z ≤ δ ∧ (A y r δ).2 ≤ φ (β * r ^ 2 / δ)) →
                        have L := Real.log (α * R ^ 2 / ε) / Real.log 4;
                        have N := ⌈L⌉₊;
                        have r := fun k => R / 2 ^ k;
                        have run := fun t =>
                          Nat.rec (x₀, 0)
                            (fun k p =>
                              have w := A p.1 (r k) (α * r k ^ 2 / 8);
                              (w.1, p.2 + w.2))
                            t;
                        have last := A (run N).1 (√(ε / α)) ε;
                        have C := (run N).2 + last.2;
                        ↑N ≤ max 0 L + 1 ∧
                          (N = 0 ↔ α * R ^ 2 ≤ ε) ∧
                            ‖(run N).1 - z‖ ≤ r N ∧
                              f last.1 - f z ≤ ε ∧
                                C ≤ N * φ (8 * (β / α)) + φ (β / α) ∧
                                  ↑C ≤ (max 0 L + 1) * ↑(φ (8 * (β / α))) + ↑(φ (β / α)) ∧
                                    (φ (β / α) ≤ φ (8 * (β / α)) →
                                      ↑C ≤ (max 0 L + 2) * ↑(φ (8 * (β / α))) ∧
                                        (4 ≤ α * R ^ 2 / ε → ↑C ≤ 3 * L * ↑(φ (8 * (β / α)))))
approved_definition_context: ContDiff R 1 f means continuously Frechet differentiable on the whole space.
StrongConvexOn Set.univ alpha f means f((1-t)x+t y)<=(1-t)f(x)+t f(y)-(alpha/2)t(1-t)||x-y||² for x,y in E and t in [0,1].
IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for every x. Product projections are .1 and .2.

Nat.rec b step defines u(0)=b and u(k+1)=step(k,u(k)). Natural ceiling ceil(a) is the least natural number at least a, hence is zero for a<=0. Real.log is the natural logarithm on positive reals. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root on nonnegative reals, totalized as zero on negative reals.
